boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented, under-21-safe Saint John’s activities and exhibition stops with free access for CSB+SJU students or the public as noted.

cards.title: Read “Lost and Found in Translation”
cards.subtitle: HMML Reading Room, Alcuin Library
cards.notes: Head to Alcuin Library’s lower level and take in HMML’s multilingual-collections exhibition at your own pace during library open hours.
cards.short_summary: A temporary HMML exhibition about language, scripts, and translation.
cards.evidence_claim: HMML lists “Lost and Found in Translation” in its Reading Room and states that admission is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Located on the lower level of Alcuin Library; open in conjunction with Alcuin Library hours.

cards.title: See original Saint John’s Bible folios
cards.subtitle: Lower level, Alcuin Library
cards.notes: Plan a self-guided look at original folios, rare books, sketches, and production tools; no reservation is needed for self-guided visits.
cards.short_summary: A permanent exhibition pairing Bible folios with manuscript material.
cards.evidence_claim: HMML states that the Saint John’s Bible Gallery is free and open to the public, with no reservation required for a self-guided tour.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Friday, 10 a.m.–4 p.m.; closed weekends and on listed holiday closures.

cards.title: Browse the Target Gallery
cards.subtitle: Saint John’s Art Center
cards.notes: Drop into the Saint John’s Art Center to view the rotating exhibition program; check the gallery schedule before making a special trip.
cards.short_summary: One of the named visual-art galleries in the Saint John’s Art Center.
cards.evidence_claim: CSB+SJU identifies Target Gallery at the Saint John’s Art Building and states that galleries on both campuses are always free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: CSB and SJU Senior Art Exhibition begins March 23 | CSB+SJU
cards.access_notes: The source identifies this as an SJU Art Building gallery; confirm the current exhibition schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Browse the Alice R. Rogers Gallery
cards.subtitle: Saint John’s Art Center
cards.notes: Use a gallery visit as a quiet meet-up: look through the current work together, then compare details or favorite pieces outside the gallery.
cards.short_summary: A named Saint John’s Art Center exhibition gallery.
cards.evidence_claim: CSB+SJU identifies the Alice R. Rogers Gallery at the Saint John’s Art Building and states that galleries on both campuses are always free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: CSB and SJU Senior Art Exhibition begins March 23 | CSB+SJU
cards.access_notes: The source identifies this as an SJU Art Building gallery; confirm the current exhibition schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Check out the Exit Gallery
cards.subtitle: Saint John’s Art Center
cards.notes: Stop by this student-gallery space while you are at the Art Center, and allow time to explore any current work without rushing through it.
cards.short_summary: The Saint John’s Art Center’s named student gallery.
cards.evidence_claim: The Art Department lists Exit Gallery as a gallery in the Saint John’s Art Center; CSB+SJU states that galleries on both campuses are always free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Saint John’s Art Center; verify current exhibition availability before visiting.

cards.title: Ski the Abbey Arboretum trails
cards.subtitle: Saint John’s Abbey Arboretum
cards.notes: When snow conditions permit, follow the directional trail guidance and borrow free rental gear through the Outdoor Leadership Center as a CSB+SJU student.
cards.short_summary: A groomed winter-trail outing with free student gear.
cards.evidence_claim: Outdoor U states it collects no trail fees and that CSB+SJU students can get free rental gear from the Outdoor Leadership Center.
cards.source_title: Nordic Skiing at Saint John’s | OutdoorU
cards.access_notes: Seasonal and weather-dependent. Follow posted trail direction and walker guidance; free gear is specifically for CSB+SJU students.

cards.title: Join the Spider Walk and Talk
cards.subtitle: Abbey Arboretum — Saturday, September 5
cards.notes: Register for the Outdoor U naturalist session and explore the arboretum with the group while learning about the spiders found there.
cards.short_summary: A guided arboretum walk focused on local spiders.
cards.evidence_claim: Outdoor U lists the September 5 Spider Walk and Talk as free for CSB+SJU students and Outdoor U members.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled 8–9:30 a.m. September 5. Registration is linked by Outdoor U; free status is specific to CSB+SJU students and Outdoor U members.

cards.title: Take the Climate Ready Woodlands field tour
cards.subtitle: Saint John’s Abbey Arboretum — Thursday, September 17
cards.notes: Bring walking-ready footwear for a presentation followed by a field tour on how the Abbey Arboretum manages its woodlands for climate change.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost presentation and field tour about woodland management.
cards.evidence_claim: Outdoor U lists Climate Ready Woodlands on September 17 as a presentation and field tour and labels it “No Cost!”
cards.access_notes: Scheduled 1–4 p.m. September 17; registration is linked on the Outdoor U event page.

cards.title: Learn animal tracking in winter
cards.subtitle: Saint John’s Abbey Arboretum — Saturday, January 16
cards.notes: Watch the Outdoor U registration page as winter approaches, then join the guided arboretum session to look for and identify animal tracks.
cards.short_summary: A guided winter outing focused on reading animal tracks.
cards.evidence_claim: Outdoor U lists its Animal Tracking Program as free for CSB+SJU students and Outdoor U members.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled 1–3 p.m. January 16; Outdoor U says registration will open soon. Free status is specific to CSB+SJU students and Outdoor U members.

cards.title: Walk the luminary route to Stella Maris
cards.subtitle: Lake Sagatagan beach to Stella Maris Chapel — February 12–13, 2027
cards.notes: Meet at the Lake Sagatagan beach for Outdoor U’s illuminated winter route across the lake to Stella Maris Chapel; dress for outdoor conditions.
cards.short_summary: A two-night illuminated winter walk across Lake Sagatagan.
cards.evidence_claim: Outdoor U states that Luminary Walks have no registration and no fees, with donations welcomed but not required.
cards.access_notes: Open to all, February 12–13, 2027, 6:30–8:30 p.m. The hike begins and ends at Lake Sagatagan beach; winter conditions apply.
